pages.title: Angry Birds Red with His Signature Angry Eyebrows and Round Classic Body Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Angry Birds Red in his classic round form, with sharply angled eyebrows, a pointed beak, and a tall feather crest. Broad open spaces fill his body and belly, while the small tail feathers and facial features provide compact details on this simple coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Guarding Three Eggs in a Nest Beneath a Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Red guards three eggs in a twig nest beneath a leafy tree in this printable coloring page, keeping his eyebrows lowered and beak pointed forward. The coloring sheet pairs his broad round body and smooth eggs with smaller overlapping twigs, grass tufts, and branching tree lines.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Pulled Back in a Wooden Slingshot Facing a Pig Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Angry Birds Red pulled back in a wooden slingshot, aiming toward a pig sheltered in a tall tower across the meadow. Stretched bands cross the foreground, while stacked beams, cracked blocks, and the slingshot's wood grain add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Crashing Through the Wooden Beams of a Pig Fortress Coloring Page
pages.description: Angry Birds Red crashes through a pig fortress in this printable coloring page, sending broken wooden beams and small splinters outward around his round body. A startled pig watches from the upper opening, with star-shaped impact marks and the tower's remaining cross braces adding angular details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Confronting King Pig Beside His Royal Throne Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Angry Birds Red confronting King Pig beside a tall royal throne, with Red's open beak facing the pig's worried expression. The crown's pointed tips and oval jewels add smaller shapes, while broad faces, throne panels, and floor stones leave larger spaces across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Discovering an Empty Nest and Following Pig Tracks Coloring Page
pages.description: Red discovers an empty twig nest and a trail of pig hoofprints in this printable coloring page, with bushes lining the route behind him. The round bird remains the largest shape on the coloring sheet, surrounded by paired footprint outlines, scattered grass tufts, and overlapping branches around the nest.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Planning an Egg Rescue with Chuck and Bomb in the Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Red planning an egg rescue with Chuck and Bomb in a meadow, gathered behind an unrolled map on the grass. A nest, castle, and dotted route appear on the map, while the birds' contrasting round and triangular silhouettes create the main coloring areas on the sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Teaching the Blues How to Use the Slingshot Coloring Page
pages.description: Red teaches the Blues to use a wooden slingshot in this printable coloring page, with one small bird in the pouch and two watching below. Rounded bodies and wide eyes give the coloring sheet broad shapes, while the slingshot's bands, wood grain, and nearby grass add narrower details.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red and Terence Facing Helmet Pigs at a Stone Castle Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Red and Terence facing two helmet pigs at a stone castle gate, with the larger bird rising behind the smaller one. Riveted helmet bands, individual masonry blocks, and a barred wooden doorway provide clear enclosed shapes around the birds on this castle coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Stopping a Pig From Lifting an Egg Basket with Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: Red stops a pig's balloon-powered egg basket in this printable coloring page, standing beside the hovering basket while the startled pig looks upward from the grass. Three large balloons and smooth egg outlines offer open spaces, contrasting with the basket's woven bands and knotted handle on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Discovering a Golden Egg Inside a Rocky Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Red discovering a Golden Egg inside a rocky cave, his wide eyes and open beak turned toward the raised stone platform. Short rays surround the egg, while angular cave walls, scattered pebbles, and the pedestal's cracked edges break the coloring sheet into varied shapes.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Beside a Sardine Can as Mighty Eagle Swoops Overhead Coloring Page
pages.description: Red sits beside an open sardine can as Mighty Eagle swoops overhead in this printable coloring page, spreading his wings above the smaller bird and clouds. The coloring sheet includes layered flight feathers, a curved beak, and three fish inside the peeled-back can, mixing broad shapes with smaller details.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Using Mighty Feathers to Defend an Egg From a Wheeled Pig Machine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Red using Mighty Feathers to defend an egg from a wheeled pig machine, with a large feather sweeping above him. The pig rides in a bolted wooden cart beneath a propeller, while curved movement lines connect the action across the open spaces of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds 2 Red Using His Battle Cry to Topple a Stone Pig Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Red uses his Angry Birds 2 battle cry to topple a stone pig tower in this printable coloring page, sending curved sound waves toward the blocks. His wide-open beak faces a tumbling pig, while cracked rectangular stones and the tower's narrow supports create angular sections on the action coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds 2 Red Wearing the Dragon Knight Hat Beside a Castle Moat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Angry Birds 2 Red wearing the Dragon Knight hat beside a castle moat, with tall curved horns above his feathered face. Segmented helmet panels and pointed decorations add detail to the foreground, while a stone bridge, rippling water, and flag-topped towers complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Space Red Curving Around a Small Planet Toward an Orbiting Pig Fortress Coloring Page
pages.description: Angry Birds Space Red curves around a small cratered planet toward an orbiting pig fortress in this printable coloring page, wearing his angular eye mask. Sweeping flight lines connect the round planet and floating castle, with outlined stars and individual castle stones adding smaller shapes to the space coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Space Red and Ice Bird Rescuing an Egg on an Icy Asteroid Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Angry Birds Space Red and Ice Bird rescuing an egg on an icy asteroid, surrounded by stars and drifting rocks. Red's rounded outline contrasts with Ice Bird's square body, while jagged crystals, circular craters, and a distant planet add varied sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Red in Knight Armor with a Sword and Shield Coloring Page
pages.description: Red defends a castle bridge in his Angry Birds Epic knight helmet in this printable coloring page, carrying an upright sword and a crown-emblem shield. The feathered helmet, riveted shield rim, and pointed blade stand out against stone paving, battlement walls, and the raised gate behind him on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Epic Red in His Samurai Helmet Facing a Ninja Pig in a Bamboo Grove Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Angry Birds Epic Red in a samurai helmet, facing a masked ninja pig between tall stalks in a bamboo grove. Curved helmet horns, layered side plates, and the sword's wrapped grip add fine sections, while the birds and bamboo stems provide broader areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Epic Red in His Paladin Helmet Protecting Chuck Beside a Medieval Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Red protects Chuck beside a medieval tower in this printable coloring page, wearing his Angry Birds Epic paladin helmet and holding a large decorated shield. A high feather plume and diamond-shaped ornaments draw attention to Red, with the tower's stone courses and narrow window forming the background of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Red with a Lightsaber Facing a Stormtrooper Pig Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Angry Birds Star Wars Red as Luke Skywalker deflecting a stormtrooper pig's laser with a lightsaber across Tatooine's rolling desert. His tunic, belt, and swept hair contrast with the pig's detailed helmet, while two suns and a domed building complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Star Wars Red as a Rebel Pilot Flying an X-wing Above the Death Star Coloring Page
pages.description: Red flies an X-wing above the Death Star as a Rebel pilot in this printable coloring page, peering from the cockpit beneath a striped helmet. Four spread wings, long laser cannons, and circular engines fill the main drawing, with the battle station's gridded panels adding smaller spaces to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Go Red Racing His Super Roaster Kart Toward a Checkered Finish Line Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Angry Birds Go Red racing his Super Roaster kart toward a checkered finish banner, gripping the wheel on a curving track. Wide tires, a rounded nose, and the rear spoiler create large outlined shapes, while wheel hubs and banner squares add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Transformers Red as Optimus Prime Facing an Eggbot on Piggy Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Angry Birds Transformers Red appears as Optimus Prime facing an Eggbot on Piggy Island in this printable coloring page, standing beside the smaller egg-shaped machine. His tall helmet, windowed chest, and blocky limbs contain many separate panels, while a palm tree and shoreline frame the robot coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Rio Red Breaking Open a Birdcage in the Smugglers' Warehouse Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Angry Birds Rio Red breaking open a birdcage in the smugglers' warehouse, with a parrot spreading its wings by the doorway. Bent bars and jagged impact marks surround Red's approach, while the cage's domed top, hanging ring, and nearby wooden crates add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Minecraft Red Facing a Block-built Pig Tower in a Grassy Voxel World Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft-style Red faces a block-built pig tower in this printable coloring page, standing on a raised grassy platform beneath a tree with a squared canopy. Cubic bodies, rectangular supports, and stepped ground edges give the coloring sheet a geometric structure, with only the characters' eyes and snouts breaking the straight lines.

pages.title: Angry Birds Dream Blast Baby Red Napping Among Pillows and Floating Dream Bubbles Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Angry Birds Dream Blast Baby Red napping among large pillows, with closed eyes and a cloud pictured inside his floating dream bubble. His small wings rest over the front cushion, while curved seams and layered pillow edges keep the coloring sheet simple and open.

pages.title: Angry Birds Summer Madness Red Canoeing with Stella on the Camp Splinterwood Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: Red and Stella canoe across the Camp Splinterwood lake in this printable coloring page, each holding a paddle beside the long curved sides of their boat. Ripples circle the paddle blades, while a distant cabin, dock, and evergreen trees provide smaller background details on this Angry Birds Summer Madness coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Summer Madness Red Retrieving a Hatchling Care Package From a Camp Cabin Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Angry Birds Summer Madness Red retrieving a hatchling care package from a camp cabin, carrying an open box against his chest. A folded blanket, baby bottle, and rattle peek above the flaps, with plank siding and an open wooden doorway adding straight-lined sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Red Dressed as a Clown Delivering a Hatch-day Birthday Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Red delivers a hatch-day birthday cake dressed as a clown in this printable coloring page, standing in a doorway with the cake held before him. His dotted hat, round nose, and ruffled collar provide distinct costume shapes, while striped candles and icing decorations add smaller details to the birthday coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Red Attending Matilda's Anger Management Circle with Chuck and Bomb Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Movie Red attending Matilda's anger management circle with Chuck and Bomb, seated on round cushions as Matilda gestures toward the group. Red folds his wings across his chest, contrasting with the other birds' smiles, while feathers, feet, and a small potted plant add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Red Painting at an Easel During Matilda's Paint-your-pain Class Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Red paints at an easel during Matilda's paint-your-pain class in this printable coloring page, holding a brush beside an angular face on the canvas. A palette with round paint wells rests in his other wing, while the wooden easel and a small paint jar add outlined details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Red Outside His Lonely Beach House with the Village in the Distance Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Movie Red outside his beach house, with a distant village visible beyond his upright figure and a seashell on the sand. His layered chest feathers and lowered wings fill most of the coloring sheet, while the house's round window and arched doorway provide smaller background shapes.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Red Climbing Mighty Eagle's Mountain with Chuck and Bomb Coloring Page
pages.description: Red climbs Mighty Eagle's mountain with Chuck and Bomb in this printable coloring page, leading the three birds along broad rocky ledges beneath a pointed summit. Red's compact figure, Chuck's tall crest, and Bomb's round body form distinct silhouettes, with cracks and sparse grass adding details to the mountain coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Red Meeting Mighty Eagle Beside His Collection of Trophies Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Movie Red meeting Mighty Eagle beside a shelf of trophies, looking upward at the much taller bird's large curved beak. Layered wing and tail feathers create long enclosed sections, while talons, trophy handles, and three cup-shaped awards add smaller details to the character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Red Using Binoculars Above Two Pig Ships Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Red looks through binoculars at the pigs' ships from a rocky mountaintop in this printable coloring page, holding the twin lenses beside his pointed beak. Two sailing ships carry pig-face figureheads below him, while sail panels, deck rails, and distant island peaks provide smaller details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Red Launching from a Slingshot Above Pig Towers Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Movie Red launching from a giant slingshot toward the rooftops of Pig City, flying above three buildings with pig-shaped upper stories. His tucked wings and trailing feet emphasize the leap, while the empty slingshot pouch, timber grain, windows, and roof details fill the lower coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Red Rescuing the Last Egg From King Mudbeard's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Red rescues the last egg from King Mudbeard's castle in this printable coloring page, running past an open gate with the egg clasped between his wings. A crowned pig emblem hangs above the arch, and the stone blocks, riveted wooden door, and pointed turret add varied shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie Red Returning the Newly Hatched Blues to Their Parents Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Movie Red returning the newly hatched Blues to their parents, with three small birds sitting together in a twig nest. Red gestures toward the family, while the adults bend their gaze toward the hatchlings; layered feathers, nest branches, and little grass tufts add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie 2 Red and Silver Planning Their Mission Beside a Map of Eagle Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Red and Silver plan their mission beside a map of Eagle Island in this printable coloring page, studying an outlined island spread across a low table. Silver points toward the route as Red rests a wing near his beak, with a mountain, dotted path, and marked destination detailing the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie 2 Red Agreeing to a Truce with Leonard at a Bird Island Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Movie 2 Red agreeing to a truce with Leonard at a Bird Island table, their raised wing and hoof meeting above it. The round wooden tabletop sits between their broad figures, while Leonard's beard, Red's feather edges, and a leaning palm add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie 2 Red and Silver Facing Zeta Beside Her Giant Ice Cannon Coloring Page
pages.description: Red and Silver face Zeta beside her giant ice cannon in this printable coloring page, standing beneath a barrel loaded with a large faceted ice ball. Zeta's sweeping crest and belted outfit contrast with the smaller birds, while cannon panels and angular rocks give this Movie 2 coloring sheet additional sections.

pages.title: Angry Birds Movie 2 Red and Silver Descending in a Harness Into the Weapon Chamber Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Movie 2 Red and Silver descending into the weapon chamber in separate harnesses, suspended from ropes above a large mounted cannon. Chest straps, buckles, and clipped loops add compact details around the birds, while the overhead pulleys and cannon barrel provide larger mechanical shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red in a Vampire Cape Beside Jack-o'-lanterns at Halloween Coloring Page
pages.description: Red wears a vampire cape beside two jack-o'-lanterns in this printable Halloween coloring page, with the tall pointed collar framing his round face and angry eyebrows. A circular clasp fastens the cape, while carved pumpkin smiles, triangular eyes, curved stems, and a fallen leaf add smaller shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Wearing a Santa Hat Beside a Decorated Christmas Tree and Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Red wearing a Santa hat beside a decorated Christmas tree and presents, with a large star above the tiered branches. Round ornaments and sweeping garlands divide the tree, while the gifts' ribbon bows and the hat's fluffy trim add smaller details to the Christmas coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Finding Patterned Easter Eggs Beside a Woven Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: Red finds patterned Easter eggs beside a woven basket in this printable coloring page, looking down at eggs decorated with spots, stripes, and zigzag bands. Three large eggs fill the foreground, while the basket's curved handle and woven sides create smaller enclosed sections on this Angry Birds Easter coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red and Stella Beside a Heart-shaped Balloon on Valentine's Day Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Red and Stella beside a heart-shaped balloon on Valentine's Day, smiling toward each other beneath the balloon's long curved string. Smaller hearts surround the pair, and a heart-shaped weight rests between their round bodies, leaving broad open spaces across the simple character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red Celebrating His Birthday with Chuck and Bomb Beside a Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: Red celebrates his birthday with Chuck and Bomb beside a cake in this printable coloring page, with all three birds smiling behind the two-tier dessert. Striped party hats, three lit candles, and curling streamers mark the celebration, while scalloped icing and small cake decorations add enclosed details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds 2 Red Wearing a Pirate Hat on Deck Beside a Wooden Ship's Wheel Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Angry Birds 2 Red wearing a pirate hat on deck beside a wooden ship's wheel, with a skull emblem above his eyebrows. The wheel's spokes and rounded handles form narrow sections, while deck planks, rail posts, and the hat's broad brim complete the pirate coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Football Red Kicking a Ball Toward the Goal for the Mighty Feathers Coloring Page
pages.description: Red kicks a ball for the Mighty Feathers in this printable football coloring page, wearing a short-sleeved uniform with the goal standing behind his spread wings. The ball's polygon panels contrast with the net's many small rectangles, while his shirt, shorts, and broad body provide larger spaces on the sports coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red in Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Angry Birds Red standing in the jungle, surrounded by broad split leaves, slender fern fronds, and looping vines above his crest. His large body and oval belly leave open coloring areas, while the layered foliage and scattered stones create finer sections around the edges of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red in Ancient Ruins Coloring Page
pages.description: Angry Birds Red sits among ancient ruins in this printable coloring page, positioned on stacked cracked blocks between a broken column and a taller surviving pillar. The bird's broad face remains central, while fluted stone shafts, crumbling capitals, and fractured paving provide smaller angular details across the ruins coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red in Harbor Town Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Angry Birds Red in a harbor town, with a fishing boat on the water and small waterfront houses beside the dock. Coiled rope, barrels, and a seagull perched on a post add foreground details, while a distant lighthouse and gentle waves complete the harbor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red at King Pig's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Red stands at King Pig's castle in this printable coloring page, rising above a crenellated stone wall with a round-windowed tower behind his classic angry face. Broad body shapes contrast with rectangular masonry, a pointed turret roof, and a distant slingshot, giving the castle coloring sheet both open areas and structural details.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red in Treehouse Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Angry Birds Red in a wooden treehouse, framed by an open doorway above a rope ladder tied to the platform. Roof shingles, plank grain, and rail posts add many narrow sections, while the surrounding trunk, branching limbs, and leafy clusters fill the detailed treehouse coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red in Egg Nest Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Red sits in the egg nest area in this printable coloring page, surrounded by spotted eggs and layered twigs with small leaves along the edges. His narrowed eyes and open beak remain prominent above his broad belly, while the egg spots and dense nest strands create smaller sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red in Asteroid Field Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Angry Birds Red in an asteroid field, with irregular cratered rocks, small stars, and two ringed planets arranged around his body. The large bird provides broad coloring spaces through the center, while rock contours, crater outlines, and narrow planetary rings give the space coloring sheet smaller details.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red in Piggy Factory Coloring Page
pages.description: Angry Birds Red stands inside the Piggy Factory in this printable coloring page, with gears, pipes, and a large machine arranged behind his round figure. Wooden crates and bolted panels add straight-edged shapes, contrasting with circular gauges and cog teeth around the broad central body on this factory coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds Red in Bamboo Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Angry Birds Red in a bamboo forest, with tall jointed stalks and narrow pointed leaves rising behind his bold round outline. Small stones, fallen leaves, and grass tufts spread across the foreground, while overlapping bamboo stems form long vertical sections around the character on the coloring sheet.
